subject: agent-subject:job-application-service-contract-gap-inspector

successEvidence: exact reusable artifact field and invariant mapping
required recommended and deferred change classification
RSI layer, protected-criterion, baseline, delta, and disposition mapping
effects on validation evaluation revision reporting and settlement

modify the reusable Agent Loop package
change shared registries or generated projections
infer service promises not present in the supplied artifacts
accept publish promote or externally update the service

the comparison would require editing or external effects
